billing_fields.job.usage(): float seconds; equals metrics()['usage']['qpu_charge_time_seconds'] for all 24 jobs; qiskit-ibm-runtime 0.49.0 documents that it returns 0 until the usage calculation is complete
billing_fields.rqc.hardware._quantum_seconds: returned the same value as job.usage() for all 24 jobs; returns 0.0 when usage is absent (fake/local modes) - so a 0 is ambiguous between 'free' and 'not yet computed'; rqc.control counts max(reported, reserved)
billing_fields.units: whole seconds in every observed job

jobs_last_28_days.ageing_out: if the window is rolling, consumption returns 28 days after each job: ~293 s free by 2026-10-18, ~570 s by 2026-10-19 08:30Z, 600 s after 2026-10-27 15:10Z (inferred)
